newsitem.title: USA: ARCO off lows after charge, down on oil.
newsitem.headline: ARCO off lows after charge, down on oil.

text.p: ARCO shares came off a low of 68 to trade down 1-13/16 at 68-7/16 after the company said it would take a charge of $0.36 per share in the second quarter.
The consensus forecast for ARCO's earnings per share excluding special items is $1.13, and the charge to buy back $756 million of its bonds would be treated as a one-time loss.
"It's just a reflection of jitters in the oil market...I would think the debt repurchase would be good news," said Adam Sieminski, analyst at NatWest Securities.

ARCO is one of the most exposed among the majors to the oil price due to its high exploration and production leverage, and Paul Ting, analyst at Salomon Bros said that it could surprise on the downside. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
